text:
samir: Quick thread to lock a "minimal GA" checklist for the inference product. We need something lighter than the big gate doc that still assures customers. Goal: ship next Tuesday.
tara: please post the mini-checklist.
samir: minimal checklist (proposed):
  - SLA baseline + compensation cap (internal + public bullets)
  - one public doc + one internal ops playbook
  - 2 runbooks: rollback, latency mitigation
  - monitoring: 3 dashboards + regression alert for token-cost delta
  - smoke test for routing+fallback (CI job)
  - pricing/quota mapping for committed tiers
  - private deploy appendix: KMS notes + audit-log retention
  - sign-off by PM, Eng, SRE, Legal (five signatories)
youssef: add canary definition: 1 hour, 5% traffic, success <1% 5xx and latency within 10% of baseline.
mona: commercial/legal: cap credits to 1 month invoice and exclude scheduled maint with 72h notice. Will draft wording.
infra-bot: note: previous dedicated rollout had region DNS lag ~18m; recommend practicing DNS failover in staging.
tara: owners: I can own docs + public FAQ. Youssef will own canary + CI smoke job. Samir owns SLO wording. Mona handles commercial language.
youssef: smoke job plan: add ./ci/ga_smoke.sh that runs 150 requests across two regions, forces a simulated region outage via env flag, asserts fallback <7% and 5xx <2%. I'll open PR. Sample snippet: ```bash
# ci/ga_smoke.sh
export GA_TEST=1
seq 1 150 | xargs -n1 -P10 curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq -r '.status' | tee results.txt
# then eval results.txt for failures/fallbacks
```
samir: SLO targets proposal: p95 small-models <150ms, medium <350ms, large <600ms; data-plane uptime 99.9%. Is everyone ok with these for initial GA?
mona: commercial ok on those numbers but want a clear escalation clause and remediation timeline in the public SLA.
infra-bot: infra constraint: ap-south region has reduced spare GPUs this week; canary may need to use synthetic token size to avoid contention.
youssef: noted, will parameterize the smoke job to scale load down if region flagged busy.
tara: monitoring: add automatic alert if token-cost/unit increases >15% vs baseline and if median latency jumps >20% over 30m. Samir, can you confirm baseline windows?
samir: baseline window = last 14 days typical traffic. Good call on both alerts.
mona: private deployment appendix: include KMS rotation steps + contact for audit logs; legal wants a one-paragraph data retention policy.
infra-bot: reminder: link to two runbooks required: rollback (RID: RB-2025-01) and latency-mitigation (RID: LM-2025-03).
youssef: timeline: PRs for docs + smoke job by Thu EOD, legal draft by Fri AM, sign-off meeting Fri 2pm. If any owner can't meet, escalate to Samir.
tara: blocked: need runtime team to confirm p95 on two largest models. Pinged runtime.
samir: will ping runtime and infra leads. I'll assemble the one-pager after PRs land and drop in #shiproom. Thanks. :thumbsup:
